slice: Suzuki RM-Z250 2017 and RM85 2022 service data from Suzuki publications (2026-11)

records.statement: The 2017 RM-Z250 is a 249 cc liquid-cooled DOHC four-stroke, 77.0 x 53.6 mm, 13.75:1 compression, fuel injected, kick start, five-speed. Curb weight 106 kg (234 lb), seat height 955 mm (37.6 in), wheelbase 1,475 mm, ground clearance 345 mm. Air-spring fork and linkage rear, 310 mm of travel at both ends. Tires 80/100-21 and 100/90-19. Fuel tank 6.5 L (1.7 US gal).

records.topic: Service schedule by races and hours
records.statement: Suzuki's schedule for the 2017 RM-Z250 counts one race as about 2 hours. Every race: inspect the spark plug, clean the air filter, inspect cooling system, clutch, cables, throttle body, fuel hose, muffler, brakes, suspension, tires, spokes and steering, and re-tighten bolts and nuts (every hour). Every 3 races (6 hours): change the engine oil, inspect the oil strainers, replace the drive chain. Every 6 races (12 hours): replace the oil filter, piston and piston ring, and check valve clearance, cylinder head and cylinder. Adjust chain slack every 30 minutes of riding. Replace coolant and radiator hoses every year and the fuel hose every 4 years.

records.topic: Valve clearance, plug, fluids and chain
records.statement: 2017 RM-Z250 service values: valve clearance cold 0.09 to 0.16 mm intake and 0.17 to 0.24 mm exhaust. Spark plug NGK CR8EIB-10, gap 0.9 to 1.0 mm. Engine oil SAE 10W-40 JASO MA: 850 ml at a change, 900 ml with the filter, 1,000 ml after an overhaul. Coolant 950 ml. Idle 2,200 plus or minus 50 r/min; ignition timing 6 degrees BTDC at idle. Chain DID 520DMA4, 114 links, slack 35 to 45 mm. Final gearing 13/49 (3.769). Tire pressure 70 to 110 kPa (10 to 16 psi) cold.

records.topic: Fork air pressure, oil level and sag
records.statement: The 2017 RM-Z250 air fork is set to 240 kPa (34 psi) as standard, measured with the fork fully extended and no load on it; Suzuki's tuning chart runs from about 220 to 270 kPa and suggests changes of 10 kPa at a time. Standard fork oil level is 115 mm. Fork compression damping standard is 7 clicks out from fully in. Rear sag target is 105 mm. The other standard clicker positions are not confirmed here.

Engine torque values for the 2017 RM-Z250: cylinder head bolts 25 Nm then 51 Nm (37 lb-ft); head cover 14 Nm; cylinder base and head base bolts 10 Nm; camshaft holder bolts 10 Nm; spark plug 11 Nm; primary drive gear nut 110 Nm; magneto rotor nut 80 Nm; clutch hub nut 90 Nm; clutch spring bolts 10 Nm; cam chain tensioner cap bolt 5.5 Nm and mounting bolts 10 Nm; crankcase, clutch cover and magneto cover bolts 11 Nm; engine oil drain plug 21 Nm and the No.2 drain plug 12 Nm; oil filter cap bolts 11 Nm; engine sprocket bolt 32 Nm; exhaust pipe nuts 23 Nm; engine mounting upper bolt 45 Nm and lower and front nuts 66 Nm.

Chassis torque values for the 2017 RM-Z250: rear axle nut 100 Nm (72.5 lb-ft); front axle nut 35 Nm; front axle holder bolts 21 Nm; fork clamp bolts, upper and lower, 23 Nm; handlebar clamp bolts 25 Nm; steering stem head nut 120 Nm; steering stem nut 45 Nm then back off 1/4 to 1/2 turn; fork cap 45 Nm; fork center bolt 75 Nm; front caliper mounting bolts 26 Nm; brake pad pins 18 Nm; brake hose union bolts 23 Nm; rear sprocket nuts 30 Nm; spoke nipples 6 Nm; rim lock 14 Nm front, 17 Nm rear; swingarm pivot nut 70 Nm; footrest bolts 35 Nm; seat rail bolts 23 Nm.

The 2022 RM85 is an 85 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke with a crankcase reed valve, 48 x 46.8 mm, a Keihin PE28 carburettor, kick start and a six-speed gearbox. The standard RM85 runs 17-inch front and 14-inch rear wheels (70/100-17 and 90/100-14), an 850 mm (33.5 in) seat and a 1,240 mm wheelbase. Fork travel 275 mm, rear wheel travel 277 mm. Fuel tank 5.0 L (1.3 US gal).

Stock jetting on the 2022 RM85 (Keihin PE28): 128 main jet, 50 slow jet, needle 24NAAH on the third clip, air screw 2 turns out, float height 19.0 mm plus or minus 0.5. Suzuki lists main jets from 115 (leanest) to 145 (richest) and slow jets from 45 to 58 for tuning to temperature, altitude and humidity. Spark plug NGK BR10ES, gap 0.7 to 0.8 mm.

Standard suspension on the 2022 RM85: fork spring 2.8 N/mm per leg, oil level 124 mm, 351 ml of fork oil per leg (Suzuki SS-05), compression 7 clicks out, rebound 1-1/2 turns out, no air pressure. Shock: spring 46 N/mm, compression 3/4 turn out, rebound 2 turns out, gas pressure 1,000 kPa (142 psi), 195 ml of oil. Fork spring free length limit 444 mm. Tire pressure 70 to 110 kPa (10 to 16 psi).

records.topic: Service schedule by races and hours
records.statement: Suzuki's schedule for the 2022 RM85 counts one race as about 2 hours. Every race: inspect the spark plug, clean the air filter, inspect the cooling system, clutch, cables, carburettor, fuel hose, muffler, sprockets and brakes. Every 3 races (6 hours): replace the spark plug, piston ring, drive chain, chain buffer and guide, change the transmission oil and fork oil, and clean the cylinder head, cylinder and exhaust valve. Every 9 races (18 hours): replace the piston. Adjust chain slack every 30 minutes of riding. Replace coolant, radiator hoses, brake fluid and brake hoses every year and the fuel hose every 4 years.

2022 RM85 service limits: cylinder bore 48.000 to 48.015 mm; piston 47.955 to 47.970 mm measured 16 mm up from the skirt, limit 47.880 mm; piston-to-cylinder clearance 0.040 to 0.050 mm, limit 0.120 mm; ring end gap 0.20 to 0.40 mm, limit 0.80 mm; crankshaft runout limit 0.05 mm. Clutch plate thickness 2.7 to 2.9 mm, limit 2.4 mm; clutch spring free length limit 39.4 mm; clutch lever play 10 to 15 mm. Transmission oil SAE 10W-40 JASO MA: 550 ml at a change, 650 ml after an overhaul. Coolant 570 ml, 50:50 mix. Radiator cap 110 kPa (16 psi).

The 2022 RM85 runs 14/47 final gearing (3.357) with a DID 428DS chain, 118 links, and 40 to 50 mm of chain slack. Replace the chain when 20 pitches measure 259 mm. Six-speed ratios: 2.545, 1.933, 1.571, 1.333, 1.166, 1.045. Primary reduction 3.444.

Torque values for the 2022 RM85: cylinder head nuts 28 Nm (20.5 lb-ft); cylinder nuts 25 Nm; spark plug 28 Nm; magneto rotor nut 35 Nm; clutch hub nut and primary drive gear nut 70 Nm; crankcase bolts 10 Nm; transmission oil drain plug 23 Nm; rear axle nut 72 Nm (52 lb-ft); front axle nut 44 Nm (32 lb-ft); fork clamp bolts 23 Nm; handlebar clamp bolts 26 Nm; steering stem head nut 65 Nm; fork cap 35 Nm; fork center bolt 55 Nm; brake caliper mounting bolts 23 Nm; brake hose union bolts 23 Nm.

Ignition tests on the 2022 RM85 (CDI, no battery): ignition coil primary 0.2 to 1.0 ohm between white/blue and ground; secondary 12 to 20 kilohms from the plug cap to ground; primary peak voltage 200 V or more. Magneto coils: 100 to 160 ohms between black/red and red/white, 140 to 230 ohms between red/white and black/white, 240 to 380 ohms between black/red and black/white. Ignition timing 15 degrees BTDC at 11,000 r/min.
